title: LL-928: The Forest Moon Explorer
description: A 1979 blue-and-grey Galaxy Explorer rebuilt by Ewok astronauts: timber fuselage, fern solar wings, twin yellow cockpits and branch-built rocket pods. Two immense living trees carry space huts, a plank skybridge and forest radar. An acorn fuel rover brings supplies to the launch clearing; a crew member transfers fuel down the skybridge boarding ramp.
